cases.name: Wendy Lynn Jones
cases.about: Wendy was part of the Lumbee tribe.
cases.narrative: On 8/24/2022, investigators found her dismembered body in a wooded area near Juanita Road. He allegedly killed her, cut her body into pieces, placed them into plastic bags, and buried them.
